---
title: "Kevin Rudd as Neo-Liberal"
date: "2009-05-21"
categories: ["Classical Liberalism"]
---

My CIS colleague, Oliver Hartwich, in [Neo-Liberalism: The Genesis of a Political Swear Word](http://www.cis.org.au/temp/OP114_Neoliberalism.pdf "Neo-Liberalism: The Genesis of a Political Swear Word"), demonstrates that when Kevin Rudd attacks neo-liberalism, he is unconsciously attacking his own intellectual heritage and heroes.
